purpose: measured boundary observations of the documented domains; they are NOT part of the frozen oracle and NOT part of the runner's exit code
expectation_rule: each expectation is computed by plain arithmetic in this file before the call and never taken from the product

probes.why: adoption_rate carries the ratio domain [0,1]; the card-specific negative uses 1.1, so this probe measures the inclusive upper edge. Demand 1000 x 1.0 = 1000, min(1000,150) = 150, 150 x 0.5 x 4 = 300
probes.expectation_source: inclusive upper edge of the ratio domain

probes.why: the quantity domain starts at 0; expected min(0 x 0.2, 150) x 0.5 x 4 = 0
probes.expectation_source: inclusive lower edge of the quantity domain

probes.why: annual_supply_capacity = 0 is the lower edge of the quantity domain and the min() must then bind on the supply side: min(200, 0) x 0.5 x 4 = 0
probes.expectation_source: inclusive lower edge of the quantity domain

probes.why: net_revenue_per_unit = 0 is the lower edge of the revenue_per_unit domain; expected min(200, 150) x 0.5 x 0 = 0
probes.expectation_source: inclusive lower edge of the revenue_per_unit domain
